findings.title: Renamed/moved functions break existing importers of mark_failed helpers
findings.body: This PR deletes `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, and `get_monitor_environment_context` from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` and moves/renames them (e.g. `mark_failed_threshold` is now `try_incident_threshold` in `sentry.monitors.logic.incidents`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence` is now `create_incident_occurrence` in `incident_occurrence`). Any existing code or tests that import these symbols from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` will fail with ImportError at import/collection time. Since the PR only updates the internals of `mark_failed.py` and does not add compatibility aliases or update callers, the author should verify no other modules or test files import the old names (e.g. `from sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed import mark_failed_threshold`) and update them, or keep thin re-export shims.
